name: AgentOrchestra / Tool-Environment-Agent (TEA) Protocol
description: AgentOrchestra is a hierarchical multi-agent framework built on the Tool-Environment-Agent (TEA) Protocol, which models environments, agents, and tools as first-class resources with explicit lifecycles. It enables continual self-evolution through a closed feedback loop, supporting dynamic instantiation and refinement of tools online during execution. Six defined transformation pathways allow flexible role reconfiguration between agents, tools, and environments, enabling the system to adapt its functional scope to evolving task requirements.
reputation: Novel protocol addressing dynamic role reconfiguration; treats self-evolution as a first-class design concern at both tool and architecture levels.
notes: Self-Evolution Module treats evolvable components (prompts, tool code, outputs) as variables for iterative optimization using methods like textgrad and self-reflection. Components can change roles at runtime (tool→agent, environment→tool, etc.).
